data.rationale: The proposal matches the core flow (type origin in "Flying from", pick the airport, optionally set flexible dates, click Search, browse the results list) and has the right origin parameter. It never mentions the BOOK tab or Map search, which are central to the true workflow, and its search_type and flexible-date handling is vague and optional. An automation could be roughly built, but it would likely miss the map search entry point.
